parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the toaster's front panel.
parts.Functional_description: Used to start or stop the toasting process, controlling the heating cycle.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A secondary plastic button on the toaster's control interface.
parts.Functional_description: May serve as a function selector, such as defrost or reheat mode.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another plastic button on the toaster's control area.
parts.Functional_description: Used to adjust browning level or cancel the toasting process.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A plastic button located near the other control buttons.
parts.Functional_description: May control additional toaster functions such as bagel mode or power.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster, typically made of stainless steel or heat-resistant plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Houses the internal heating elements, slots for bread, and control mechanisms.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary; serves as the structural support for all other components.
